desc: Implement input parsing, length-difference rejection, and common prefix/suffix trimming.
Implement a fast deterministic LCP helper using bytes/memoryview chunked comparison.
Implement exact Landau-Vishkin furthest-reaching DP over diagonals with insert/delete/substitute transitions, boundary handling, and early success checks.
Add quick small-string checks (empty after trim, max length <= K) and output Yes/No.
Test on provided samples and edge cases (equal strings, prefix/suffix, length difference exactly K, one-character strings, long periodic strings, K=20).
If the Landau-Vishkin approach fails or is too slow, implement a banded DP fallback.
